scenes.script:
Anjali says: Mere husband ki salary sirf 22,000 rupees thi.
Anjali says: Aur meri saas mujhe taunt maarti thin, "Jab English bolna nahi aata, toh 50 rupees ki cream ki kya zaroorat hai?"
scenes.on_screen_text: Husband ki salary sirf ₹22,000 thi. ₹50 ki cream ke liye taunts.

scenes.script:
Anjali says: Mera naam Anjali hai. Meri friend Rekha aur meri shaadi 2022 mein hui thi.
Anjali says: Rekha fluent English bolti thi, use ek acchi corporate job mil gayi, aur uska husband bhi accha earn karta hai.
Anjali says: Wo Mumbai ke 5-star hotels mein jaate hain.
Anjali says: Main bhi kaam karna chahti thi, par broken English ki wajah se interviews mein freeze ho jaati thi.
Anjali says: Mujhe sabzi khareedne ke liye bhi paise maangne padte the.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Rekha: Fluent English, acchi job, 5-star hotels.
Anjali: Broken English, sabzi ke paise ke liye struggle.

scenes.script:
Anjali says: Ek din maine apni life badalne ka socha, aur Supernova AI download kiya.
Anjali says: Main Miss Nova se mili, jo meri personal AI teacher hain.
Anjali says: Unhone mujhe koi generic lessons nahi diye. Mera level analyze karke mere liye ek personalized plan banaya.
Anjali says: Maine hazaron mistakes kiye, par unhone mujhe kabhi judge nahi kiya. Bas mujhe Hindi mein correct kiya.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Supernova AI download kiya.
Miss Nova: Personal AI Teacher.
Aapka level analyze karti hain.
100% Private & No Judgement.

scenes.script:
Anjali says: Dhire-dhire mera confidence badha. Aur maine ek job interview clear kar liya!
Anjali says: Jaldi hi, main meetings mein bolne lagi aur client calls handle karne lagi.
Anjali says: Kyunki maine sach mein bolkar practice ki thi, na ki sirf grammar books padh kar.
Anjali says: Kuch hi months mein, mere boss ne meri progress notice ki aur mujhe promotion de diya.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Job interview clear kiya!
Meetings aur client calls mein English.
Bolkar seekha, sirf padh kar nahi.

scenes.script:
Anjali says: Ab main ghar ke kharchon mein help karti hoon, aur meri saas bhi mujhse respect se baat karti hain.
Anjali says: Kyunki meri English strong hai, aur main ab financially independent hoon.

Anjali says: Reels scroll karke ghanton waste karna band karo.
Anjali says: Supernova AI ko din mein sirf 15 minutes do.
Anjali says: Install par click karo, Miss Nova se milo, aur aaj se hi English bolna start karo.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Reels scroll karna band karo.
Sirf 15 mins ek din mein.
Install par click karo.
Aaj hi English bolna shuru karo.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the 'Family / narrative drama' register to ensure natural family honorifics (respectful plural 'thin' and 'karti hain' for the mother-in-law, and 'unhone' for Miss Nova). Applied T5 to swap the language reference from Marathi to Hindi. Ensured the hook opens with a native word ('Mere husband ki...'). Kept all brand names, product terms, and numbers in their designated English/numeral formats as per T2.

violations.quote: Mere husband ki salary sirf 22,000 rupees thi. Aur meri saas mujhe taunt maarti thin, "Jab English bolna nahi aata, toh 50 rupees ki cream ki kya zaroorat hai?"
violations.why: The script realistically depicts domestic conflict and financial distress (poverty) rather than using clearly fictional, absurdist, or aspirational framing.
violations.fix: Focus the opening hook on a relatable, lighthearted confidence barrier or professional aspiration instead of realistic domestic taunts and low income.

violations.quote: Mujhe sabzi khareedne ke liye bhi paise maangne padte the.
violations.why: The script exploits realistic poverty and extreme financial dependency as a motivator, which is prohibited under the sensitive themes policy.
violations.fix: Focus on the professional and social limitations of not speaking English fluently, rather than extreme financial distress.

safety.summary: The ad violates G5.1 by realistically depicting domestic conflict and severe financial distress (poverty) as motivators instead of using fictional or aspirational framing.
